reached_sql:
WITH filtered_data AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ws.ws_quantity, wr.wr_refunded_cash, wr.wr_fee, r.r_reason_desc
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND d.d_year = 1998
    JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    JOIN reason r ON wr.wr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON ca.ca_address_sk = wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd1 ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd2 ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
    WHERE ca.ca_country = 'United States'
      AND cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status
      AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status
      AND CASE
            WHEN cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary'
                THEN ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00
            WHEN cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College'
                THEN ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00
            WHEN cd1.cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree'
                THEN ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00
            ELSE false
        END
      AND CASE ca.ca_state
            WHEN 'NC' THEN ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200
            WHEN 'TX' THEN ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200
            WHEN 'IA' THEN ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200
            WHEN 'WI' THEN ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300
            WHEN 'WV' THEN ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300
            WHEN 'GA' THEN ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300
            WHEN 'OK' THEN ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250
            WHEN 'VA' THEN ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250
            WHEN 'KY' THEN ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250
            ELSE false
        END
)
SELECT substr(r_reason_desc, 1, 20), avg(ws_quantity), avg(wr_refunded_cash), avg(wr_fee)
FROM filtered_data
GROUP BY r_reason_desc
ORDER BY substr(r_reason_desc, 1, 20), avg(ws_quantity), avg(wr_refunded_cash), avg(wr_fee)
LIMIT 100
